title: BPW-2026-0518
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0518
CD 15
AFE – SOUTH COAST AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT DISTRICT (SCAQMD)
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $156,000 for encumbrance of funds to pay fees and licenses required by the SCAQMD for the period of July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027. Authorize the President or two members of the Board of Public Works to execute this service agreement.
(AE27760517M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
summary: Authority for Expenditure of $156,000 to pay SCAQMD (South Coast Air Quality Management District) fees and licenses for July 2026 through June 2027.
